object.name: evi.limiterfast~
object.digest: A fast no-lookahead limiter with anti-aliased nonlinear clipping
object.description: A basic stereo limiter. Being a no-lookahead limiter, the 'crunch' can kick in quite easily. <o>evi.limiterfast~</o> features an anti-aliased antiderivative hard clipping function to deal with this. Other than that it features fixed hard attack, a settable soft knee, variable smoothing, release time set in ms. The AGC envelope is available at the far right outlet.

outlets.description: Left limited audio output, might be crunchy.
Right limited audio output, might be crunchy.
The AGC envelope used internally, available here for downstream processing or visualisation.

attributes.name: ingain
attributes.description: Artificially engage the limiter by increasing @ingain. This is the reverse of a 'threshold'. Smoothed internally.

attributes.name: knee
attributes.description: Nearer 0, the knee is hard, nearer 1 the knee is soft.

attributes.name: release
attributes.description: The release time of the envelope detector. The object is tuned to work well with short times.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smoothing factor of the envelope response. 0 = not smooth at all, 1 = aggressively smoothed.
